name: Lintel & Sill
tagline: An architecture practice in a Georgian house, with its paper on one Core.

building.concept: A stone-coloured terrace house on three floors, with sash windows and a columned porch.

story: Lintel & Sill is a small architecture practice. Its people draw house extensions and shopfronts across three floors. The drawings, the post and the hours sit on the Core in the old pantry.
limits: Email, the bank and the pay service stay with the services that run them.
The site visit is out of frame, and clients and consultants outside cannot reach the Core.
